stories.headline: Builder confidence falls to a 14-year low
stories.body: Confidence among U.S. single-family home builders fell three points to 29 in October, the lowest reading since June 2012. The NAHB/Wells Fargo Housing Market Index, released October 19, also showed prospective-buyer traffic dropping five…

stories.headline: Printing-writing paper shipments fall 9% in September
stories.body: The American Forest & Paper Association reported October 19 that September printing-writing paper shipments were 9% below September 2025. Inventories declined 6% from August 2026.

stories.headline: Final lumber reviews establish new company-specific deposits
stories.body: Commerce published final results of its 2024 Canadian softwood-lumber duty reviews on October 19. The antidumping review lists margins of 17.00% for Canfor, 4.71% for West Fraser, 13.13% for Resolute and 10.64% for the non-selected companies…

stories.headline: Ntityix and Tolko pair tenure rights with a 15-year fibre customer
stories.body: Westbank First Nation’s Ntityix Resources and Tolko announced an agreement to transfer Forest Licence A98912 to Ntityix, alongside a 15-year fibre-supply agreement. The announcement is dated October 14 and was posted by Ntityix October 15.…

stories.headline: Ocala seeks crews for 1,575 acres of stand improvement
